_about: Evaluation set for scripts/fire_spread/evaluate.py: Catalan wildfires whose DARP
perimeter (data/fire_spread/raw/incendis/<year>) grew essentially unchecked for the
scored horizon, so a free-burning simulation is comparable with the observed extent.
code = DARP CODI_FINAL. start_utc = ignition time (UTC); hours = the horizon that was
free-burning (the DARP perimeter is the final one, so a fire contained after 6 h is
scored on a 6 h run). ignition = [lat, lon] when the origin is known, otherwise the
upwind-most burnable perimeter vertex is used. Times are from press / Bombers de la
Generalitat public briefings and are approximate to the hour; edit here, rerun, and

fires.name: La Torre de l'Espanyol (Ribera d'Ebre) 2019
fires.notes: Started early afternoon 26 June during the June 2019 heat wave; ran free through the night and the 27th (~6 000 ha).

fires.name: Artesa de Segre / Baldomar (Noguera) 2022
fires.notes: Started mid-afternoon 15 June 2022 (heat wave); free-burning through the night, ~2 700 ha. Earlier hindcasts: bias 0.92-1.05, the reference free-burning case.

fires.name: El Pont de Vilomara (Bages) 2022
fires.notes: Ignited around midday 17 July 2022; ~1 600 ha in one afternoon/evening under W-NW wind with spotting, then held. Score the first 12 h.

fires.name: Santa Coloma de Queralt (Conca de Barberà) 2021
fires.notes: Started early afternoon 24 July 2021, ~1 700 ha; main run the first afternoon and night.

fires.name: Corbera d'Ebre (Terra Alta) 2022
fires.notes: Same 15 June 2022 episode as Baldomar; ~370 ha DARP perimeter, largely one afternoon-night.

fires.name: Castellar de la Ribera (Solsonès) 2022
fires.notes: 15 June 2022; ~320 ha. Earlier hindcasts: J 0.49-0.53 (tuned), the best-fit case.

fires.name: Portbou (Alt Empordà) 2023
fires.notes: Tramuntana-driven spring fire, ~480 ha in hours; time approximate (DARP date 16 April 2023).

fires.name: Batea (Terra Alta) 2024
fires.notes: 11 May 2024, ~430 ha in one afternoon; time approximate.
